# ICUHUB

> Standalone integration hub: vendor connectors, credential broker, action policy and approvals, audit, and OCSF/SARIF normalization, exposed to internal platforms through REST, MCP, an event stream, and webhook ingress. No AI code. Phase 0 (design).

## Instructions
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): canonical rules for AI coding agents and humans

## Design
- [Business requirements](docs/BRD.md): goals, scope, requirements (BR/FR/NFR), integration catalog, risks, open decisions D1-D8
- [High-level design](docs/HLD.md): components, data model, connector framework, pipelines, REST/MCP/events/webhooks, security, deployment, consumer contract, roadmap
- [Communication matrix](docs/COMMATRIX.md): every network flow with ports, auth, and examples
- [Connector guide](docs/CONNECTOR_GUIDE.md): checklist for adding a vendor connector
- [Architecture decisions](docs/adr/README.md)
